note: microcopy-golden-02-payment-sync.md is severity-3-heavy on purpose, to show that a genuinely bad screen does not get softened by the output bound: every finding here clears severity 3 so none is suppressed. NNG-EM-CONSTRUCTIVE fires twice on the same script logic golden-01 exercises. The three judged findings are where this example earns its place: NNG-EM-PROXIMITY and NNG-EM-SEVERITY-CONTAINER both fire on the card-number message and both track this skill's own severity-3 anchors closely, a validation error banished to a separate error-summary section reached by scrolling away, and a checkout-blocking failure shown in a toast that clears itself, exactly the anchor's own toast example. NNG-EM-GRACE fires on the sync-status message at medium confidence rather than high, because unlike the other two findings it rests on reading the screen context as a whole, that this status line is the only notice of an unrecoverable loss, offers nothing else, and states the failure in bare technical language, rather than on a single stated field. That confidence distinction is itself part of what the golden demonstrates: not every judged call is equally certain, even when the criterion clearly fires.
